message.what: A significant solar flare occurred early this morning from a large, complex active region. A coronal mass ejection may have been produced.
message.when: Potential Earth impacts are possible later this week. Timing remains uncertain while imagery and model analysis continue.
message.confidence: Low. Early imagery and the location of the eruption suggest an Earth-directed component is possible.
message.impacts: If an Earth-directed coronal mass ejection is confirmed, geomagnetic activity could affect HF communications, satellite navigation, satellite operations, and power systems, particularly at high latitudes.
message.additional_details: No Space Weather Watch or Warning is in effect for this event at this time. A Space Weather Watch may be issued if additional imagery and model guidance indicate possible significant impacts to Earth.
message.next_update: No later than 1800 UTC Wed May 08 2024, or sooner if conditions change.
